goal: Milestone: Perplexity independently operating from NouGen canon and live fleet state
body:
## What happened
Perplexity, connected as a NouGen provider lane, used the live MCP connector to verify fleet identity and configured backends, consulted shard memory and recall semantics, then layered current MCP security research on top to generate a concrete local-agent integration guide.

## Why this matters
This is evidence of the architecture crossing from manual context transfer into provider-portable operational memory. Dave did not need to restate the system from scratch. The lane could orient itself from NouGen, distinguish live backend truth from generic assumptions, and produce work grounded in the shared substrate.

## Durable design signal
NouGen should continue optimizing for model interchangeability: memory, provenance, routing, relay, and verification remain stable while cloud and local model lanes can rotate in and out. New lanes should bootstrap by reading fleet identity, checking coverage/trust state, consulting shards and relays, then performing external research only where needed.

## Done when
Treat this as a milestone reference for onboarding and documentation. Future provider integrations should be tested against the same bar: can a newly connected lane recover enough verified NouGen context to perform useful work without Dave manually re-teaching the stack?
